The HWPX project proposal generation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, confirming the core document automation logic is functional.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.83 across a single trial. The pytest suite in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite passed successfully in 0.10 seconds. While the run was successful, the 8m 58s total runtime suggests potential inefficiencies in the document generation or broadcast process that should be monitored.
